result:
I would remove the capacity for willful ignorance. 

I would make it so that the moment a person chooses to ignore a provable truth, or turns away from the suffering of another simply because acknowledging it would be inconvenient, they would feel a profound, inescapable psychological weight. 

Not physical pain, but the heavy, piercing clarity of absolute empathy and objective reality. 

If we could no longer lie to ourselves about the consequences of our actions, the fragility of the earth, or the humanity of the people we overlook, the systems we build would have to reflect that unavoidable truth. The world would change instantly, driven not by forced compliance, but because the luxury of looking away would no longer exist.
